column1: # slug|impact,uniqueness,significance,experience,depth|category overrides or -|individual rationale
trang-an-landscape-complex|9.6,9.7,9.5,9.6,9.5|-|Exceptional navigable karst and human heritage landscape; some scope overlaps Tam Coc sub-area, but full ensemble remains globally strong.
hue-imperial-city|9.5,9.6,9.7,9.4,9.3|-|Important Nguyen imperial complex; distinguish from Hue Citadel nested site and avoid treating all palace buildings alike.
hoi-an-ancient-town|9.3,9.5,9.3,9.5,9.2|-|Exceptional living port-town urban fabric, though not equal in scale to complete ancient imperial capitals.
my-son-sanctuary|9.2,9.6,9.6,9.2,8.9|-|Rare Cham temple sanctuary with archaeological significance, but less surviving breadth than Angkor's larger complexes.
cu-chi-tunnels|8.8,9.1,9.3,8.8,8.4|-|Historically consequential tunnel network with engaging tours, but exhibits are a partial reconstruction and visitor scale is limited.
lan-ha-bay|9.4,9.5,8.7,9.4,9.0|-|Beautiful limestone seascape, but adjacent Ha Long shares the globally outstanding geomorphology and broader iconic scope.
cat-ba-archipelago|9.2,9.2,8.9,9.1,9.2|-|Rich island and limestone habitats with good exploration, but overlap with Ha Long/Lan Ha reduces independent singularity.
con-dao-islands|9.2,9.4,9.0,9.3,9.1|-|High-quality archipelago with critical national history and nature, without near-perfect global singularity.
con-dao-national-park|9.1,9.3,9.0,9.2,9.2|-|Important sea-turtle and island habitat; island-scale protected system must be distinct from entire archipelago holiday experience.
ha-giang-loop|9.2,9.4,8.7,9.3,9.0|-|Outstanding mountainous multi-day route, but separate natural scenery from the cultural and logistical qualities of a road trip.
mu-cang-chai-rice-terraces|9.1,9.2,8.8,9.1,8.7|-|Extraordinary agricultural landscape, although terrace systems in the Philippines and China offer global comparators.
cao-dai-holy-see|8.8,9.2,9.0,9.1,8.1|-|Unusual syncretic religious architecture, yet worldwide significance and size below older major pilgrimage sanctuaries.
po-nagar-cham-towers|8.7,9.2,9.1,8.9,7.7|-|Important surviving Cham towers with distinctive architecture, but small compound is not an Angkor-scale visit.
yen-tu-mountain|8.9,9.1,9.1,9.0,8.8|-|Significant Buddhist pilgrimage mountain and hiking, with global significance below much larger sacred peaks.
temple-of-literature|8.7,8.9,9.2,8.9,8.0|-|Major Vietnamese scholarly and Confucian heritage, but one contained temple has less scope than capital-city monumental ensembles.
marble-mountains-da-nang|8.8,8.8,8.4,8.9,8.0|-|Memorable limestone caves and shrines, but limited standalone geological and archaeological significance globally.
cai-rang-floating-market|8.2,8.5,8.2,8.6,7.9|-|Culturally valuable working river market, yet its short present-day visit should not inherit the entire Mekong Delta's depth.
war-remnants-museum|8.8,9.1,9.5,9.1,8.7|-|Major difficult-war-history collections and perspective; meaningful experience, with smaller breadth than entire national memorial complexes.
ba-be-national-park|9.0,9.2,8.9,9.1,9.0|-|Distinctive tropical karst lake and forest, but multiple comparably significant national park landscapes exist globally.
tram-chim-national-park|8.9,9.2,9.1,8.8,8.9|-|Important seasonal wetland and endangered bird habitat; visitor access and viewing opportunities do not equal ecological value.
cat-tien-national-park|9.1,9.3,9.2,9.1,9.2|-|Important lowland forest and wildlife conservation, with specialized visits distinct from global biological significance.
mekong-delta|9.2,9.3,9.3,9.1,9.5|-|Large transboundary river-delta culture and ecology deserve broad scope, but local excursions should not inherit whole-basin impact.
tam-coc-bich-dong|9.1,9.3,8.6,9.3,8.6|-|Superb karst boat ride and temples, but nested within the wider Trang An-area landscape and less unique independently.
ban-gioc-waterfall|9.2,9.4,8.5,9.2,8.3|-|Remarkable border cascade, but shorter waterfall visit and global science significance are below iconic large landscape complexes.
independence-palace-hcmc|8.7,9.0,9.4,9.0,8.5|-|Significant modern political-history building, but a standalone palace museum does not inherit the entire war history.
golden-bridge-ba-na-hills|8.4,8.9,7.9,8.6,7.0|-|Distinctive contemporary pedestrian bridge primarily valued for photo impact, with modest history and visit depth.
tra-su-cajuput-forest|8.8,9.0,8.2,9.0,8.5|-|Attractive wetland forest boat route, yet not as globally irreplaceable as enormous protected biodiversity reserves.

can-gio-mangrove-biosphere|8.6,9.0,8.8,8.6,8.7|nature=9.0,wildlife=9.0|UNESCO biosphere reserve protects a restored tidal mangrove habitat near Ho Chi Minh City, but boardwalk and boat tourist visits do not equal global reserve-wide ecological or exploration depth. Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/mab/can-gio-mangrove

dong-van-karst-plateau|9.3,9.5,9.2,9.3,9.3|-|Distinctive large karst highland and minority cultural landscapes with substantial multi-day exploration, but geomorphic rarity should not be directly equated with entire Phong Nha transboundary karst park. Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/iggp/geoparks

fansipan-summit|8.9,9.0,8.5,8.9,8.1|photography=9.2|Highest peak of mainland Vietnam and excellent mountain viewpoint reached by cable-car or trek; a summit visit has less independent ecosystem depth and uniqueness than the entire Hoang Lien range. Source: https://vietnam.travel/

ha-long-bay|9.8,9.9,9.7,9.8,9.6|-|Retain iconic marine-invaded tower karst seascape, globally outstanding geology, cruises and archipelago depth; UNESCO property expanded with Cat Ba archipelago in 2023. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/672/

ho-chi-minh-mausoleum|8.6,8.9,9.3,8.6,7.5|-|Internationally consequential Vietnamese political memorial with ceremonial significance but short focal-point visitor experience, not the scale of the surrounding Ba Dinh cultural district. Source: https://vietnam.travel/

hue-citadel|9.1,9.3,9.5,9.1,8.9|-|Important broad citadel enclosing imperial and forbidden cities, but these nested sites must be differentiated rather than each receiving the full UNESCO Hue monuments ensemble depth. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/678

imperial-citadel-thang-long|9.0,9.2,9.6,9.0,8.6|-|Important stratified dynastic capital and archaeological remains in Hanoi; despite UNESCO status surviving visitor fabric offers less immediate visual impact and breadth than Forbidden City. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/vn

ma-pi-leng-pass|9.0,9.1,8.2,9.2,7.3|-|Extraordinary cliff road and Nho Que River panorama but a focused mountain pass with viewpoints, not the entire Ha Giang Loop multi-day landscape; depth score should reflect the specific site. Source: https://vietnam.travel/

minh-mang-tomb|8.8,9.0,9.0,9.0,8.0|architecture=9.1,history=9.1|Distinguished imperial tomb and landscaped palace precinct within Hue UNESCO monument cluster; avoid a near-unique global 9.5 for a single dynastic tomb complex. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/activities/318/

museum-cham-sculpture|8.7,9.2,9.2,8.9,8.4|history=9.3,culture=9.3|Da Nang museum contains an important dedicated collection of Cham sculpture, with narrow specialist focus relative to the world's widest major Asian-arts museum collections. Source: https://vietnam.travel/

nui-chua-national-park|8.9,9.2,8.8,8.8,8.8|-|UNESCO-recognized biosphere reserve spans tropical dry forest and marine turtle habitats; ecological merit strong, but visitor activities and forest variety below huge tropical national parks. Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/mab/nui-chua

phong-nha-cave|8.8,9.2,8.5,9.0,7.9|-|Memorable navigable cave tour with extraordinary karst development, but tourists normally explore a limited boat-access segment rather than the entire cave system or national park. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/cave-country-phong-nha/

phong-nha-ke-bang-national-park|9.8,9.9,9.7,9.7,9.8|-|Retain globally outstanding karst, cave system and biodiversity of major UNESCO park; 2025 transboundary extension with Laos supports landscape-level conservation significance. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/951/

son-doong-cave|9.9,9.9,9.6,9.0,9.2|-|Retain rare gigantic cavern passage and exceptional cave expedition, while specialist multi-day access yields different experience than easier broad sightseeing. Cave has globally defining scale within protected Phong Nha karst. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/951/

yok-don-national-park|8.8,9.1,8.8,8.7,8.8|wildlife=9.2|Distinctive Vietnamese dry dipterocarp woodland and ethical elephant-friendly viewing; visitor breadth and global rarity are more modest than large iconic safari ecosystems. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/vietnams-first-ethical-elephant-experience/

kon-ka-kinh-national-park|8.7,9.1,8.7,8.5,8.8|nature=9.1|Kon Ka Kinh is a core zone of the Kon Ha Nung UNESCO biosphere with endangered grey-shanked douc; conservation value is strong but wild forest trails do not guarantee 9.5-depth mainstream visitor experience. Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/mab/kon-ha-nung-highland

tu-duc-tomb|8.6,9.0,9.1,8.8,8.1|architecture=9.1,history=9.1|Poetic landscaped Nguyen imperial tomb remains important within the Hue complex, but a single tomb has less international singularity and scale than the full royal city. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/678

u-minh-ha-national-park|8.7,9.0,8.6,8.4,8.7|nature=9.2,wildlife=9.1|Rare Melaleuca peat-swamp ecosystem in Mekong Delta has conservation value, but fragile specialized wildlife habitat does not imply world-class tourist exploration across all dimensions. Source: https://en.nbca.gov.vn/vuon-quoc-gia-u-minh-ha-ca-mau/

con-son-kiep-bac-heritage|8.6,9.1,9.4,8.7,8.8|-|Con Son and Kiep Bac form genuine components of the recently inscribed Truc Lam Buddhist UNESCO serial landscape, but the individual local area should not inherit all the wider four-location heritage depth. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1732

cham-islands|8.8,9.0,8.4,9.0,8.7|nature=9.1,photography=9.1|Cham Islands are part of Cu Lao Cham–Hoi An UNESCO biosphere with coral reefs and island forests, but scenic island beaches are globally comparable and should not receive near-reference 9.5 nature automatically. Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/mab/cu-lao-cham-hoi

pu-luong-nature-reserve|8.7,8.9,8.1,9.0,8.9|nature=9.1,photography=9.0|Protected limestone forest and agricultural terraces create an attractive multi-day rural landscape, but it is less singular than the internationally leading karst parks and heritage terraces. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/pu-luong-nature-lovers/

con-dao-prison-complex|8.7,9.1,9.5,8.6,8.8|-|Extensive infamous former prison complexes and political-memory sites justify exceptional historic significance, though on-site visitor breadth is smaller than a complete national memorial landscape. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/explore-con-dao-heroic-history-and-eco-tourism-experiences/

po-klong-garai-towers|8.5,9.0,9.1,8.6,7.5|architecture=9.1,history=9.1,culture=9.1|Distinctive surviving Cham Hindu temple towers and ritual heritage, but a compact hilltop group is not 9.5-unique compared with Angkor, My Son or larger South Asian temples. Source: https://dulichso.khanhhoa.gov.vn/en/explore/po-klong-garai-towers-0bc

hoang-su-phi-rice-terraces|8.9,9.0,8.5,9.0,8.7|nature=9.2,photography=9.4|Large cultivated terrace landscape and living ethnic agricultural traditions, but compare internationally with Cordillera Philippine terraces and Yuanyang before granting 9.5 nature significance. Source: https://dantoc.vietnamtourism.gov.vn/en/hoang-su-phi-terraced-rice-fields-a-brocade-painting-in-the-middle-of-the-sky/

paradise-cave|9.0,9.2,8.5,9.2,8.2|-|Keep category nature 9.5 for truly exceptional long dry cave stalactite architecture, while total score appropriately distinguishes the visitor cave from Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park. Source: https://phongnhakebang.vn/travel/dong-thien-duong13-en

khai-dinh-tomb|8.7,9.1,8.9,8.8,7.6|architecture=9.2,photography=9.1|Highly ornate and unusual late-Nguyen royal tomb with elaborate mixed decorative styles, but a contained mausoleum should not inherit full Hue UNESCO scale. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/678/maps/

trang-an-boat-route|8.8,9.0,8.2,9.3,7.8|nature=9.2,photography=9.3|Trang An's boat circuit offers scenic tower-karst waterways and caves, but this one itinerary is only a component of the much wider UNESCO mixed cultural-natural landscape. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1438/

an-thoi-archipelago|8.8,8.8,7.6,9.0,8.2|nature=9.0,photography=9.1|Scattered small snorkeling and beach islands south of Phu Quoc provide attractive boat-trip scenery, but globally comparable tropical archipelagos limit uniqueness and single-day depth. Source: https://visitphuquoc.com.vn/en/how-many-islands-are-in-the-an-thoi-archipelago-a-complete-a-z-exploration-guide-14436

phu-quoc-island|8.7,8.7,8.0,8.9,9.0|nature=9.1,beaches=9.2|Large island contains forests, varied beaches and coastal settlements, but combined appeal is not near-unmatched globally and should not inherit top-tier national park ecology as one rating. Source: https://www.vietnamtourism.com/maps/phu-quoc-map-en.pdf?dl=1&v=20261008b

son-tra-peninsula|8.7,8.9,8.5,8.9,8.7|nature=9.2,photography=9.1|Coastal forested headland supports rare red-shanked douc and dramatic bay views; important regional wildlife site but separate from a far larger protected tropical forest. Source: https://danangfantasticity.com/en/see-and-do/the-son-tra-peninsula

ca-mau-cape-national-park|8.5,9.0,8.7,8.4,8.5|nature=9.1|Important coastal mangrove and ecological frontier within UNESCO-designated Ca Mau biosphere, yet typical visit and diversity are more constrained than giant wetland park systems. Source: https://en.nbca.gov.vn/cong-cu-bao-ton/xac-lap-cac-khu-vuc-bao-ve-bao-ton/cac-khu-vuc-bao-ton-co-danh-hieu-quoc-te/khu-du-tru-sinh-quyen/

bidoup-nui-ba-national-park|8.6,9.0,8.7,8.7,8.9|nature=9.2|Montane forest habitat and biodiversity are significant within Lang Biang biosphere, while visitor trails and park-scale uniqueness are more modest than world reference rainforests. Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/mab

oc-eo-archaeological-site|8.4,9.1,9.3,8.2,7.8|history=9.3|Archaeological evidence of ancient Funan-era maritime trade has notable Southeast Asian significance but fragmentary excavated visitor fabric lacks the immersive scale of Angkor-type remains. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/tentativelists/6572/

ba-be-lake|8.8,9.0,8.3,9.1,8.5|nature=9.2,photography=9.2|Remarkable large natural freshwater lake and karst forest, with independent lake excursions distinct from Ba Be National Park's broader habitat and multi-day exploration. Source: https://en.nbca.gov.vn/khu-ramsar-ho-ba-be-tinh-bac-kan-2011/

bach-ma-national-park|8.7,9.0,8.9,9.0,8.9|nature=9.3,wildlife=9.0|Ecologically rich humid montane forest supports diverse birds and mammals, but genuine conservation importance should be distinguished from exceptional world-wide sightseeing singularity. Source: https://en.nbca.gov.vn/vuon-quoc-gia-bach-ma/

forbidden-purple-city|8.5,8.9,9.2,8.7,8.1|architecture=9.2,history=9.4|Hue's Forbidden Purple City housed Nguyen royal family life inside the larger imperial citadel, but much original fabric was damaged and the named inner palace should not inherit the scope of the entire UNESCO Hue monument complex. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/vn

japanese-covered-bridge-hoi-an|8.3,8.7,8.6,8.6,7.2|architecture=9.0,history=9.0|The celebrated Japanese Covered Bridge is a compact symbolic monument within UNESCO Hoi An; its short walk-through visit and narrower history should not receive the exploration depth of the whole trading town. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/vn

ngo-mon-gate|8.3,8.7,8.9,8.6,7.3|architecture=9.2,history=9.3|Ngo Mon Meridian Gate is a magnificent entry structure to Hue Imperial City, with strong design and royal symbolism but smaller standalone scope than the citadel and wider UNESCO Hue ensemble. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/vn

cat-ba-national-park|8.8,9.1,8.9,9.1,9.1|nature=9.4,wildlife=9.3|Cat Ba National Park contributes forests, rare island fauna and trekking to the wider UNESCO Ha Long Bay–Cat Ba Archipelago property; ecological value is meaningful without automatically equating one national park to all limestone islands and bays. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/vn

hang-en-cave|9.4,9.5,9.0,9.3,9.1|-|Hang En is one of the world's largest natural cave passages, visited through a full jungle expedition with overnight camping inside, so it warrants much greater intrinsic impact and uniqueness than an ordinary cave but not the full Phong Nha park's breadth. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/cave-country-phong-nha/

hai-van-pass|8.8,8.8,8.0,9.0,8.1|-|Hai Van is a dramatic coastal mountain road offering panoramic views between Hue and Da Nang, but a focused drive and lookout stop has less standalone heritage significance and exploration depth than a long multi-day route. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/must-do-da-nang-an-insider-list/

ben-duoc-tunnels|8.8,9.0,9.4,9.1,8.2|-|Ben Duoc is a historic and larger-distance access section of the Cu Chi tunnel network, significant for wartime underground survival and interpretation without inheriting the entire Vietnam War or the full tunnel system's significance. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/7-must-see-attractions-hcmc/

dien-bien-phu-battlefield|9.1,9.4,9.8,8.9,9.0|-|The Dien Bien Phu battlefield complex preserves hills, bunkers and fortified positions at the decisive 1954 battle that transformed colonial history; wide multi-site military-history experience merits much more historic significance than a generic museum. Source: https://vietnam.travel/place-to-go/northern-midlands-mountains/dien-bien/

cuc-phuong-national-park|9.0,9.1,9.2,9.0,9.3|-|Cuc Phuong was Vietnam's first national park, with broad lowland forest ecosystems, primate conservation and hiking routes; its ecological depth is greater than a single lake or forest walkway, but not as rare as global mega-parks. Source: https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/7-amazing-national-parks-vietnam/

tu-lan-cave-system|9.2,9.4,8.7,9.1,9.2|-|Tu Lan covers multiple dramatic karst caves reached on specialist forest and river expeditions, with substantial exploration depth but not the same world-record size or scientific significance as Hang Son Doong. Source: https://vietnam.travel/place-to-go/north-central-coast/phong-nha/

thien-mu-pagoda|8.8,9.0,9.3,8.9,8.1|-|Thien Mu is an important historic seven-tier pagoda overlooking the Perfume River and part of Hue's broader UNESCO-monument setting, but the compact temple is less wide-ranging than the full imperial city. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/678

phu-quoc-national-park|8.8,8.8,8.6,8.8,8.9|-|Phu Quoc's large interior forest protects tropical island habitat and hiking scenery, but conservation significance and typical trail access are more limited than mainland rainforests or complete archipelago excursions. Source: https://vietnam.travel/place-to-go/southern-vietnam/phu-quoc/
